cardOverview.overviewText: A simple FD-backed cashback credit card that gives you up to 5% cashback on online spends, 1% on UPI and offline spends, and a total cashback cap per statement while letting you earn interest on your fixed deposit linked to the card.

benefitRows.name: Road Side Assistance
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary roadside assistance worth ₹1,399, up to 4 times in a year.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, your IDFC FIRST credit card must be active. Call the dedicated roadside assistance helpline provided on your card to access complimentary roadside assistance services worth ₹1,399, up to 4 times per year. For details, contact IDFC FIRST Bank customer care at 1860 267 3333.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary personal accidental insurance cover of ₹2,00,000
